summary: 504 Modernization and Small Manufacturer Enhancement Act of 2026 This bill generally expands the Small Business Administration (SBA) 504 Loan Program to include additional objectives and flexibilities (e.g., new economic development objectives that may be used to qualify for assistance under the program). The program provides a small business with SBA financing—through a certified development company intermediary—for expansion or modernization. Specifically, the bill expands the public policy goals that allow an intermediary to qualify for assistance to include additional objectives. These include (1) workforce development through work-based or work-integrated training, and (2) aiding the revitalization of an area for which a disaster has been declared or determined.
